Spend a weekend at the nearest dog park and pet stores; recruit 15 owners.
Ask nurse friends to share it in their ward group; one ward is enough to start.
Contact your university's international office and the exchange-student society.
Join local parent groups and prenatal classes; offer it free to the first 30 families.

Message founders of 10 small remote startups on LinkedIn or X and offer a free pilot.
Find small landlords in local property groups and set up their first building for them.

Cold-email 20 planners you find on Instagram with a 60-second demo video.

Usage tracking with a free monthly quota

Invite links so every user brings friends

local: Listings with location, hours and photos
Reviews with photo proof to cut spam
education: Bite-sized lessons with a daily streak
A progress dashboard for learners and teachers
professional: Profiles built around skills and proof of work
Search and filters for the people who hire

Leaderboards with friends or a club

Bank or UPI data import with clear consent
Talk to a compliance expert before handling real transactions

daily.title: Shift-swap board for hospital wards
daily.pitch: Nurses post and claim open shifts in two taps, and the ward manager approves from their phone.
daily.problem: Shift swaps live in chaotic WhatsApp groups and paper rosters, so managers lose track of who is actually covering.
daily.whoPays: Ward managers and small private hospitals.
daily.pricing: $3 per nurse per month; first ward free for 60 days.
mvp: Import the roster from a spreadsheet
Post a shift, claim a shift
WhatsApp or SMS alerts for open shifts
daily.firstUsers: Ask three nurse friends which ward runs swaps on WhatsApp, then offer that ward a free setup.

daily.title: Club manager for college societies
daily.pitch: Members, events, dues and QR attendance for student clubs, in one place instead of five spreadsheets.
daily.problem: Every year the new committee inherits messy sheets, unpaid dues and no record of who attended what.
daily.whoPays: Student councils and college activity offices, as a campus license.
daily.pricing: Free for one club; $49 per month for a whole campus.
mvp: Dues collection through UPI or card links
Handover mode for next year's committee
daily.firstUsers: Run it for your college's two biggest clubs this semester, then pitch the student council with their numbers.

daily.title: Polite invoice chaser for freelancers
daily.pitch: Connect your invoices and it sends friendly, escalating reminders until you get paid.
daily.problem: Freelancers hate chasing clients, so late invoices sit for weeks and cash flow suffers.
daily.whoPays: Freelance designers, developers and small agencies.
daily.pricing: $9 per month.
mvp: Add an invoice by upload or forwarded email
Reminder schedule with three tone levels
daily.firstUsers: Offer a free overdue-invoice audit in two freelancer communities and follow up with everyone who replies.

daily.title: Fee and attendance app for tuition centers
daily.pitch: Batches, attendance, fee reminders and parent updates for small coaching classes, run from one phone.
daily.problem: Tuition owners track fees in notebooks and chase parents one phone call at a time.
daily.whoPays: Owners of coaching and tuition centers with 30 to 300 students.
daily.pricing: $15 per month per center; free under 25 students.
daily.firstUsers: Visit five tuition centers near your college with a one-page demo and set up the first one for free.

daily.title: Five-minute status page for tiny SaaS
daily.pitch: Uptime checks and a clean public status page, priced for products with 10 customers, not 10,000.
daily.problem: Small teams skip status pages because the big tools are pricey and take an afternoon to set up.
daily.whoPays: Indie hackers and two-to-ten person software teams.
daily.pricing: $5 per month for five monitors and one status page.
mvp: HTTP checks every minute from two regions
Public status page with incident notes
daily.firstUsers: Offer it free to 20 makers launching this month in exchange for the badge in their footer.

daily.title: Mock-interview matcher for placement season
daily.pitch: Pairs juniors with seniors who cracked the same companies for 30-minute mock interviews.
daily.problem: Students prepare alone while the seniors who already got those offers are one message away but hard to schedule.
daily.whoPays: College placement cells; students pay for slots with alumni.
daily.pricing: $99 per semester per college; alumni slots at $5 each.
mvp: Seniors list the companies and roles they cleared
Built-in video link and feedback form
Leaderboard of the most helpful seniors
daily.firstUsers: Get 15 final-year students from your batch to host slots, then share the booking link in the junior groups.

daily.title: Renewal tracker for neighborhood gyms
daily.pitch: Shows which memberships expire this week and sends renewal nudges automatically.
daily.problem: Small gyms lose members simply because nobody reminded them their plan ended.
daily.whoPays: Owners of single-location gyms, yoga and martial-arts studios.
daily.pricing: $12 per month per location.
mvp: Member list with plan end dates
daily.firstUsers: Offer three gyms near you a free import of their register and track the renewals you save them.

daily.title: Show notes from a podcast episode, automatically
daily.pitch: Upload an episode and get a transcript, chapters, show notes and three social clips to review.
daily.problem: Small podcasters spend hours on show notes and chapter markers after every episode.
daily.whoPays: Independent podcasters and small podcast agencies.
daily.pricing: $19 per month for four episodes.
mvp: Export to the podcast host's description field
daily.firstUsers: Process the latest episode of 20 small podcasts for free and email each host the result.

daily.title: Ticketing and QR check-in for college fests
daily.pitch: Sell passes, scan them at the gate, and watch live headcounts for every event in the fest.
daily.problem: Fest teams juggle Google Forms, payment screenshots and long gate queues.
daily.whoPays: Fest committees and event clubs.
daily.pricing: A small fee per ticket sold; free for free events.
mvp: Live dashboard of entries per event
daily.firstUsers: Run check-in for one department event for free, then pitch the main fest committee with the queue times you saved.

daily.title: No-show reducer for small clinics
daily.pitch: Appointment reminders with one-tap confirm or reschedule, so empty slots get refilled.
daily.problem: Dentists and small clinics lose hours every week to patients who forget appointments.
daily.whoPays: Independent clinics, dentists and physiotherapists.
daily.pricing: $25 per month per practitioner.
mvp: Reminders a day and two hours before
daily.firstUsers: Ask your own dentist how many no-shows they had last month, then offer a free month to cut that number.

daily.title: Rent reminders and receipts for small landlords
daily.pitch: Automatic rent reminders, payment links and clean receipts for landlords with a few units.
daily.problem: Small landlords chase rent over text and scramble for receipts at tax time.
daily.whoPays: Landlords with 2 to 20 units.
daily.pricing: $2 per unit per month.
mvp: Monthly reminders with a pay link
daily.firstUsers: Find landlords in local property groups and offer to set up their first building for them.

daily.title: Internship application tracker
daily.pitch: A simple pipeline for every application, deadline and follow-up, like a CRM for your job hunt.
daily.problem: Students apply to 50+ roles across portals, emails and sheets, and miss follow-ups.
daily.whoPays: Students on a freemium plan; placement cells for cohort dashboards.
daily.pricing: Free for 15 applications; $3 per month after that.
mvp: Save roles with a browser button
daily.firstUsers: Share it in your batch's placement group before the next hiring cycle opens.

daily.title: Low-stock alerts for small shops
daily.pitch: Scan purchase bills and get a reorder list before best-sellers run out.
daily.problem: Small shops run out of top items because stock lives in the owner's head.
daily.whoPays: Neighborhood grocery stores, pharmacies and stationery shops.
daily.pricing: $8 per month per store.
mvp: Product list built from purchase bills
Quick daily count or sales tally
One-tap order message to the supplier
daily.firstUsers: Spend a Saturday setting it up at one shop, then ask them to introduce you to their supplier's other shops.

daily.title: Photo selection app for wedding photographers
daily.pitch: Clients heart favorites from thousands of photos, and the photographer gets a clean final list.
daily.problem: Couples send favorites as WhatsApp screenshots, and photographers spend days matching file names.
daily.whoPays: Wedding and event photographers.
daily.pricing: $15 per month for unlimited galleries.
mvp: Export selected file names for editing
daily.firstUsers: Message 30 wedding photographers on Instagram with a 60-second demo using their own sample photos.

daily.title: Judging and scoring tool for hackathons
daily.pitch: Judges score projects on a shared rubric from their phones, and the leaderboard updates live.
daily.problem: Hackathon judging runs on paper sheets and a frantic spreadsheet at 2 a.m.
daily.whoPays: Hackathon organizers, tech clubs and companies running internal hacks.
daily.pricing: $29 per event; free for student events under 50 teams.
mvp: Judge assignments per room or track
daily.firstUsers: Offer it free to the next hackathon at your college and at two nearby colleges.

daily.title: Alumni mentor matching for one college
daily.pitch: Students request 20-minute chats with alumni by role, company and city.
daily.problem: Alumni want to help, but students don't know whom to ask and cold messages go unanswered.
daily.whoPays: Colleges and alumni associations.
daily.pricing: $1,000 per year per college, with a free pilot semester.
mvp: Alumni profiles with 'ask me about' topics
daily.firstUsers: Recruit 25 alumni from your own department through LinkedIn, then launch it to your batch.

daily.title: Testimonial collector for small businesses
daily.pitch: Send one link, collect text or video testimonials, and embed a clean wall of them on your site.
daily.problem: Great customer feedback gets lost in DMs and email instead of helping sell.
daily.whoPays: Coaches, course creators, small SaaS and local services.
daily.pricing: Free for 10 testimonials; $12 per month for unlimited.
mvp: Shareable collection form for text and video
daily.firstUsers: Collect testimonials for three local businesses for free and publish their walls as case studies.

daily.title: Portfolio site from your GitHub, in one click
daily.pitch: Turns your repos and READMEs into a clean portfolio page recruiters actually read.
daily.problem: Students have good projects on GitHub but no portfolio that explains them.
daily.whoPays: Students and junior developers on a freemium plan.
daily.pricing: Free on a subdomain; $4 per month for a custom domain.
mvp: Custom domain and a recruiter-view counter
daily.firstUsers: Build portfolios for 20 friends in your batch and share the best ones in developer communities.

daily.title: Daily specials menu updated by WhatsApp
daily.pitch: The owner sends a WhatsApp message and the QR menu on every table updates instantly.
daily.problem: Small restaurants print menus that go stale and can't show daily specials or sold-out items.
daily.whoPays: Cafés and small restaurants.
daily.pricing: $10 per month per location.
mvp: Update items and prices by WhatsApp message
daily.firstUsers: Set it up for your favorite café near campus for free and ask the owner to refer two neighbors.

daily.title: Bill splitter for shared flats and hostels
daily.pitch: Tracks rent, electricity and groceries per flatmate, with UPI or card links to settle up.
daily.problem: Flatmates argue over who paid for what, and the math gets messy when people move in and out.
daily.whoPays: Students and young professionals; co-living operators for a branded version.
daily.pricing: Free for one flat; $2 per month for recurring bills and receipts.
daily.firstUsers: Start with your own flat and two friends' flats, then post in hostel and PG groups near campus.

daily.title: Changelog widget for small apps
daily.pitch: Write updates once and show them in-app, on a public page and in a monthly email.
daily.problem: Small teams ship constantly, but users never notice new features and churn.
daily.whoPays: Small SaaS teams and indie app makers.
daily.pricing: $9 per month for one product.
daily.firstUsers: Offer free setup to 15 indie makers who post weekly updates on X or Reddit.

daily.title: Rubric grading tool for teaching assistants
daily.pitch: Grade assignments against a rubric with reusable comments, then export marks in one click.
daily.problem: TAs rewrite the same feedback a hundred times and copy marks into the college portal by hand.
daily.whoPays: Departments and TAs at colleges and coaching institutes.
daily.pricing: Free for one course; $39 per month per department.
mvp: CSV export in the portal's format
daily.firstUsers: Ask two TAs in your department to grade one assignment with it and time how long it takes.

daily.title: Bill and warranty locker
daily.pitch: Snap a bill once and get reminded before the warranty or return window runs out.
daily.problem: People lose bills and miss free repairs or returns on things they already paid for.
daily.whoPays: Consumers on a freemium plan; electronics stores for a branded version.
daily.pricing: Free for 10 items; $1 per month for unlimited and family sharing.
mvp: Photo upload with date and product fields
daily.firstUsers: Post a short 'never lose a bill again' video in your city's local groups and collect the first 100 users.

daily.title: Volunteer scheduling for small NGOs
daily.pitch: Volunteers pick shifts from a link, get reminders, and the NGO sees hours logged for reports.
daily.problem: Small NGOs coordinate volunteers over spreadsheets and calls, and people forget their shifts.
daily.whoPays: Small NGOs and community groups, often from grant budgets.
daily.pricing: Free under 30 volunteers; $15 per month after.
daily.firstUsers: Volunteer with one NGO for a weekend and set it up for their next drive.
